resources.string: Customers join with one tap (the password is fixed, not secret)
QR code for joining the customer WiFi

Becomes the DIRECT-… network name. The password is fixed by the app (shown on the dashboard and in the QR) - it is a technical formality; the voucher is the real gate. WiFi Direct needs Location permission and Location switched ON (Android refuses to create any WiFi network otherwise).

Android only lets an app create a WiFi network (a WiFi Direct group, which is how this app works) when it has location permission - and Location must also be switched on in the system settings. Without it the gateway cannot start, and it starts automatically the moment the grant is confirmed.
